_finding: A peg reading is read against the session of the primary listing: a reference held over a weekend or a holiday is expected, held during a regular session it is not. A session module that guesses `regular` on a day it has no calendar for, ignores a holiday, or keeps the 16:00 close on an early-close day, turns a held reference into a fresh-looking one on exactly the days the series exists to capture (Thanksgiving and the day after).

mutations.name: a year past the calendar is treated as a normal trading year
mutations.expect: FAIL a date past the last covered year is unknown, not regular

mutations.name: holidays are ignored
mutations.expect: FAIL Thanksgiving 2026 at noon is closed, holiday named

mutations.name: an early-close day closes at 16:00
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and at 13:00 it is after hours
